messages.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT
messages.notes: If GUTI allocated, Start T3450; Stop T3430

notes: The figure shows two alternative flows separated by 'OR'
Timer T3430 is started when UE sends TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
Timer T3430 is stopped when UE receives TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT or TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT
Timer T3450 is started by MME when GUTI is allocated in TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT
Timer T3450 is stopped when MME receives TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE
